content: Pauli akikengelela palonge jha Agilipa
Bhahe, Agilipa ajhakunnobholela Pauli, “Ngohe mihoto kukikengelela kwa kulonge malobhe ghino.” Bhahe, Pauli ajhakukigholola na kutumbuu kulonge.
“Munahota nkolongwa Agilipa! Nibhona unoghe hake kujhema palonge jhino deleno kulonge mambu ghoha gha matakalilo ghubhandakalile Akayahude panane jhango.
Nihangana hake nhwalo mwenga mabhene umanye ghumaghayobhalile ghoha gha Akayahude na homo yabhe. Bhahe, ninnyopa nhimbilile nenga.
“Akayahude bhoha bhamanye nenga kuhumii nhwana gwango, chindamita kuhumii makacho ku kilambo chango cha ku Yeluchalemo.
Bhamanyite hake kwa machiko ghamahele, anda bhapala mihoto kulonge kubhehe kuhumii makacho, nikibha mulilongo lya Mapwalichayo lilikamuu hake malaghalikilo gha dine jhito.
Ngoheno nijhema pamba nihobholela kwa nhwalo gwa ghala ghalaghila Chapanga na akahoko bhito.
Chalongela Chapanga ndi makabila kome na mabhele gha kilambo chito, bhanyinamila Chapanga kilo na muhe. Kwa nhwalo munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude abhandikana na kihobholelo chenie!
Bho, nhwalo ghane ghulimbite mangota kujheketela, Chapanga kwayokecha bhando bhubhawile?
“Chakaka nenga nijheketela ambwika nahenga ilebhe mbwe mukulikana liina lya Yecho jwa ku Nachalete.

Na mambu ghanga ndi ndehila ku Yeluchalemo. Namwete, nikapatite ukindendeke kubhoke kwa akapiya matambiko bhakolongwa, nyakwatabha bhando bhamahele bha Chapanga. Na bhene pibhahadabwila bhankomwe na nenga nikajheketile.

Machiko ghoha natehila bhatyalwe munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude yoha na kwatendela kindalaha bhakikane kihoholelo chabhe. Helahela lilaka lyango kwabhe lijhakubhehe likolongwa hilu nyakwatendela mmengo ade miche jha kutale.
Pauli ilongela chaghombokwike
“Bhahe, nyakujhenda ku muche gwa Damasiko kwa machiko ghagha, mii na ukindendeke na lilaghalikilo lya akapiya matambiko bhakolo.

Mwe munahota punikibha undela, chaa chita pakalamuhe, nyakubhona lumule lukolongwa kupeta lwa lyobha lung'anyima lubhokila kunane kwa Chapanga. Lujhakundindila ndaa nenga pamonga na ajhango bhutukibha na nenga mumwanja.

Twenga twabhoha tujhakugwe pahe puu, nyakujhoha lilobhe likalongela kwa lugha jha Kiebulaniya, ‘Saule, Saule, nhwalo ghane ming'aha nenga? Mukilaghicha jhajhe anda ng'ombi jwatakula ntakula luyato lwa jwalucha.’
Bhahe, nenga pungonyita, ‘Mwe mwa ghane, Bhambo?’ Na Bhambo panyangwila, ‘Nenga ndi Yecho jhuming'aha naha.

Nambo jhema, jhema kwa makongono ghino nkangamale Pauli apelwa lihengo lya kutangacha malobhe gha Chapanga kwa bhando bhange. Nimpitile mwenga mma matumiche bhango. Mwenga chimalongolela bhando mambu ghumaghawene deleno na ghala ghughahika.
Nanikombola kubhoke mu mabhoko gha bhando bha ku Ichilahele na bhando bha ilambo henge. Nanituma mwenga kwabhe.

Namwapenula miho ghabhe na kwatenda bhabhoke mulubhendo na kujhingila mulumule. Bhabhoke pahe jha Limbembela na kughalambukila Chapanga. Kwa kujheketila kwabhe bhapate kulekekewa uhakaho na kutola chehemo jhabhe pakate jha bhando bhubhahaghulilwe na Chapanga.’
Pauli ichimulila lihengo lyake
“Kwa nhwalo ghongo, mwe munahota nkolongwa Agilipa, nenga nekite jhe kughajheketela ngita chinnobholilwe mu uloto ghubhokita kunane kwa Chapanga.

Nambo nikatumbuu hote kutangacha kwa bhando bha ku Damasiko, na bha ku Yeluchalemo na bha kilambo cha ku Yudeya, helahela kwa bhando bha ilambo henge. Nikatangachile bhajheketile na bhauleke kubhoke mu ahakaho gwabhe na bhang'alambukile Chapanga na kulangiya matendelo kubhehe miojho jhabhe ilekite gheniya.
Nhwalo gwa gheniya, Akayahude bhajhakungamula nkate jha Nyumba jha Chapanga, na kupala kungoma.

Nambo Chapanga akandangatile ade deleno nyemite pamba nilongela ghala ghunighawene. Na nenga nilongela kulangiya kwa bhando bhoha, bhubhamanyikana na bhangamanyikana. Ghinilongela ndi ghala milondole bha Chapanga na Mucha bhakalongi naghapitila,
kubhehe Kilichitu Nkomboche nang'ahika na jhojho natumbula kuyoka kubhoka kubhawile, na atangache malobhe ghamaha gha ughombokeko kwa bhando bha ilambo yoha Akayahude na bhangabhehe Akayahude.”
Pauli pakibha mukikengelela, Fesito ajhakunobholela kwa lilobhe likolongwa, “Gwee Pauli, nkwete ngholoka! Kuchoma kwino kuntenda mme na ngholoka.”
Nambo Pauli ajhakujhanguu, “Nduna Fesito, nenga ngwete jhe ngholoka. Malobhe ghinongile ndi gha chakaka na ghina mana.
Munahota nkolongwa Agilipa nihoto kulonge palonge jhino changakiholo nhwalo umanye mambu ghoha. Chakaka manyite mwenga muijheketela ilebhe yoha ipitila kwa nhwalo itendika pakongoloho.
Munahota nkolongwa Agilipa, bho, majheketela milondole bha Chapanga? Nimanya mwajheketila!”
Na jwenio Agilipa ajhakunyanguu Pauli, “Bho, pumihambuka mu mwojho gwino kwa machaa ghandina mihoto kutenda nenga Nakilichitu?”
Pauli ajhakujhanguu, “Ninyopa Chapanga, kwa machaa gwamahele amu ghandina, chi mwee tugha, bhoha bhamba bhubhanyokiya pambano bhabhehe ngita chimi nenga, nambo changatabha minyololo jhenio!”
Peniya munahota nkolongwa Agilipa ajhakujhinuka, na nduna jwa liboma na Belenike na bhange bhoha bhubhakibha bhatamite pamonga na bhene helahela bhajhakujhinuka.
Na bhene pubhapitita panja bhajhakupwepwelana, “Mundo hojho atehi ndeka kilebhe chikitope akomwe amu apungwe.”
Agilipa ajhakunobholela Fesito, “Mundo hojho ngadindulilwe nakujhopa jhe kujhenda kuhadabulwa na munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma.”
